profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
More than ten years of experience developing software for embedded software systems in C language. Specialist in Automotive area in communications: CAN protocol (2.0 / FD), Customer Diagnostics, Flash BootLoader. Interfaces with different communication protocols like CAN, RS232, SPI, Ethernet, USB and ISA. 

Master Degree of Science in Computer Science with research in FPGAs, Embedded Systems and Parallel Computer Field applied to Image Processing.

Experience with debugging tools, software development process and related tools.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer
positions.description:
Software Developer for Airbag Control Units with different microcontrollers.
Mainly focused on Communication: Flash Bootloader, CAN and Customer Diagnostics for customers like FCA, GM (Global A and B), Honda and PATAC.
Plenty experience in Full Software Development Lifecycle: Requirements Analysis, Design, Coding, Module Verification and Validation.
Collaboration with teams in different countries.

positions.title: Team Leader (FPGA Team)
positions.description:
•	Planning, Coordination and Assignation of activities for team.
•	MicroBlaze usage for Ethernet communications.
•	Ethernet protocol definition to communicate ML403 and PC.
•	Develop of VisualC application for image transmission.
•	Programming and developing embedded systems: Parallel architectures with FPGAs.

company.name: Prefixa Vision Systems, S.A. de C.V.

positions.title: Team Leader – Project: Uranus Tool
positions.description:
•	Developing of Embedded Systems for image processing.
•	Programming and developing embedded systems: Parallel architectures with FPGAs.
•	Programming and Developing Protocol Communication between PC and FPGA prototyping Cards.
•	Drivers developing to interface with FPGAs prototyping boards.
•	Synthesis, Implementation and FPGA programming using Xilinx Tools.

positions.title: ABAP Jr. Consultant
positions.description:
•	ABAP interfaces and reporting:
  -	Batch Input Interfaces
  -	Call Transactions Interfaces
  -	ALV Reporting
  -	Interactive Reporting

positions.title: Algorithm Programmer
positions.description:
Project: Secretaría de Marina – CONACYT (Marina-2003-02-11896)

•	Programming and developing Computer Vision Algorithms in FPGA prototyping boards.
•	Design and implementation of architectures for Digital Image Processing.
•	Developing Interfaces Hardware – Software with Handel-C
•	Tests with Celoxica Boards.
•	Simulation and Validation using Celoxica Tools.
•	Synthesis, Implementation and FPGA programming using Xilinx Tools.

positions.title: Software Systems Developer
positions.description:
•	Programming and developing Systems with C++ and Delphi.
•	Web Pages.
•	UML and Object Oriented technologies usage.
•	Preventive and corrective maintenance to PCs.
